dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minimal deviation; a subtle convex curvature is visible on the right lateral margin compared to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a high median pixel intensity across the majority of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; isolated, faint grey clusters are localized near the posterior region and anterior head area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between subtle pigmented variations and the primary depigmented canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, dark-pixel linear marks and small circular points on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle, parallel linear marks (likely rake marks) are visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
